posts.title: Don't Let LLMs Play Telephone With Your Ideas
posts.description: A prompt is for communicating an idea to an LLM. If you tell your idea to an AI agent and ask it to write down in its own words, say, a “skill” document which is meant to be a reusable piece of prompt to attach to another LLM session, it becomes a classic game of telephone.
